query:
SELECT a.award_id, a.source_award_no, a.title, i.name AS institution, a.end_date, a.total_amount
FROM award a
JOIN institution i ON i.inst_id = a.inst_id
WHERE a.end_date BETWEEN @today AND @today + INTERVAL @months MONTH
ORDER BY a.end_date
